headline: Norse Atlantic Airways suspends flights and warns of potential bankruptcy
summary: Norwegian airline Norse Atlantic Airways has suspended all flights and stated its finances are critical, warning it will file for bankruptcy without urgent short-term financing.
why: Airlines operate on tight profit margins and high fixed costs, making them exceptionally vulnerable to liquidity shortages and sudden disruptions in travel demand or financing.

impacts.name: Norse Atlantic Airways
impacts.why: Suspension of all flights and critical financial status directly threaten the company's going concern.
